# Ultron — Multi-Agent Security Analysis Engine

> A local-first multi-agent system that finds security flaws in source code — combining AST analysis, IR-based taint propagation, and specialized LLM agents.

**Version:** 8.0.0 | **Language:** Python 3.10+ | **License:** MIT

## Quick Start

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python ultron.py https://github.com/user/repo
```

Requires: system `git`, [Graphviz](https://graphviz.org/download/) for SVG rendering.

## Core Architecture

Ultron is a pipeline of independent phases, each producing cached output consumed by the next:

```
[URL] → [Clone] → [AST] → [IR Pipeline] → [Taint Engine] → [Rules + LLM] → [Report + SVGs]
```

### Phase 1 — AST Parsing (`parser.py`)
Tree-sitter walks all detected languages (Python, JS, TS, TSX, Go, Rust, Java, C#, C, C++, PHP, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift), extracting functions, classes, imports, calls, and returns. Output: `workspace/<repo>/ast/ast.json`.

### Phase 2 — IR Pipeline (`extractors/`)
- **JsTsExtractor** (`extractors/js_ts.py`) — walks tree-sitter CST → `IRModule` with `IRFunction`, `IRCall`, `IRAssign`, `IRBranch`, `IRReturn` nodes + provenance edges + semantic tags
- **SymbolResolver** (`extractors/resolver.py`) — global function index with three-tier call resolution (exact → receiver-type → qualified)
- **CallGraph** (`extractors/call_graph.py`) — directed caller→callee graph with DFS path finding and cycle protection
- **TaintEngine** (`extractors/taint_engine.py`) — backward propagation from sinks to sources through provenance edges; inter-procedural, sanitizer-aware (VALIDATION_GATE), deduplicated

### Phase 3 — Detection
- **Rules Engine** (`rules.py`) — 7 decorator-registered deterministic rules (missing auth, SQLi, path traversal, SSRF, etc.)
- **LLM Detector** (`llm_detector.py`) — pre-filters trivially-safe flows, then runs multi-turn agentic analysis (READ_FILE, READ_FUNCTION, RECORD_FACT, FINISH) with consistency reconciliation

### Visualization
- **Dependency Graph** — role-colored file/function call graph
- **Taint Graph** — source→intermediate→sink propagation paths
- **Security Graph** — flow chains + Auth/Database/Network subgraphs

## Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ultron.py` | CLI entry point, interactive REPL, pipeline orchestrator |
| `ir.py` | Intermediate Representation data model (11 dataclass types) |
| `llm_client.py` | Local (Ollama/llama.cpp) & Cloud (Groq/Gemini/NVIDIA) LLM clients with caching, rate limiting, fallback |
| `llm_detector.py` | Agentic LLM vulnerability detection with multi-turn tool use |
| `rules.py` | Deterministic rule engine with decorator-based registration |
| `parser.py` | Multi-language tree-sitter AST parser (13 languages) |
| `cloner.py` | Git clone, pull, list, delete operations |
| `detector.py` | Language/framework detection via marker files and extension counts |
| `graph.py` | Dependency graph builder + Graphviz SVG renderer |
| `taint_graph.py` | Taint propagation SVG renderer |
| `security_graph.py` | Security graph builder (flows, auth/db/network subgraphs) |
| `extractors/js_ts.py` | JS/TS → IR extraction (847 lines, convention-based tagging) |
| `extractors/resolver.py` | Cross-file call resolution (3-tier) |
| `extractors/call_graph.py` | Directed call graph with DFS path finding |
| `extractors/taint_engine.py` | Backward taint propagation engine (428 lines) |
| `ultron_config.json` | User configuration (LLM mode, models, API keys, rate limits) |
| `requirements.txt` | Dependencies: tree-sitter + language grammars + graphviz |

## CLI Reference

```
ultron <url>                      Clone repo and run full analysis
ultron scan <name>                Re-analyze cloned repo
ultron list                       List cloned repos
ultron delete <name>              Delete clone + workspace
ultron delete --all               Delete all clones + workspaces
ultron visualise <name>           Regenerate SVGs from cached AST
ultron config                     Show config
ultron config <key> <val>         Set config value
ultron config reset               Reset config to defaults
```

### Flags
- `-v` / `--verbose` / `-d` / `--debug` — detailed tracing
- `--visualise` / `--visualize` — open SVGs in browser
- `--no-llm` — skip LLM detection (deterministic rules only)
- `--mode local` / `--mode cloud` — override LLM mode

### Interactive Mode
Run `ultron` with no arguments. Commands: `list`, `scan`, `delete`, `visualise`, `config`, `help`, `exit`.

## Configuration

File: `ultron_config.json`. Manage via `ultron config`.

### Key Settings
| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `llm_mode` | `local` | `local` or `cloud` |
| `use_llm` | `true` | Enable/disable LLM detection |
| `verbose` | `false` | Tracing by default |
| `visualise` | `false` | Auto-open SVGs |
| `temperature` | `0.1` | LLM generation temperature |
| `max_tokens` | `512` | Max tokens per response |
| `timeout` | `30` | LLM API timeout (seconds) |
| `num_workers` | `3` | Parallel worker threads |
| `llm_url` | — | Local LLM base URL |
| `enable_cache` | `true` | Cache LLM responses |
| `cache_only` | `false` | Only use cached results |

### Model Overrides
```
ultron config classifier <model>
ultron config detector   <model>
ultron config exploiter  <model>
ultron config reporter   <model>
ultron config default    <model>
```

### Cloud Providers
Set API keys in `ultron_config.json`:
- `groq` — `gsk_...`
- `gemini` — `AI...`
- `nvidia` — `nvapi-...`

Chain: `["groq", "gemini", "nvidia"]` with automatic fallback.

## IR Data Model (`ir.py`)

11 dataclass types with JSON round-trip:

### Expressions (value-producing)
- `IRVar` — variable reference
- `IRLiteral` — string, number, boolean, null
- `IRAccess` — property access (e.g. `req.body.id`)
- `IRCallExpr` — call within an expression

### Statements
- `IRCall` — function/method call statement
- `IRAssign` — assignment statement
- `IRBranch` — if/else branch
- `IRReturn` — return statement
- `IRFunction` — function definition

### Metadata
- `CallResolution` — maps call node to resolved target
- `Edge` — data-flow provenance edge (source→target with transform, conditions, confidence)
- `Tag` — semantic tag (SOURCE_HTTP, SINK_DATABASE, VALIDATION_GATE, etc.)
- `IRModule` — per-file container (functions, edges, tags, call_resolutions)

All nodes use deterministic 7-char hex IDs via MD5.

### Semantic Tag Categories
- **Sources:** `SOURCE_HTTP_BODY`, `SOURCE_HTTP_QUERY`, `SOURCE_HTTP_PARAMS`, `SOURCE_HTTP_HEADERS`, `SOURCE_ENV`, `SOURCE_SESSION`, `SOURCE_FILE_READ`
- **Sinks:** `SINK_DATABASE`, `SINK_SHELL_EXEC`, `SINK_FILE_WRITE`, `SINK_NETWORK`, `SINK_HTTP_RESPONSE`
- **Operations:** `OP_COERCION` (type cast), `OP_VALIDATION` (sanitization), `OP_AUTH` (auth check)
- **Gates:** `VALIDATION_GATE` (raises sanitizer confidence to 0.85)
- **Entry Points:** `HTTP_ENDPOINT`, `HTTP_ROUTE`, `EXPORTED_FN`

## LLM Infrastructure

### Local Client (`LocalLLMClient`)
- Auto-detects Ollama, llama.cpp, or OpenAI-compatible API
- Methods: `complete()`, `batch_complete()`, `is_available()`, `is_model_available()`

### Cloud Client (`CloudLLMClient`)
- Supports Groq, Gemini, NVIDIA with automatic fallback chain
- Features: rate limiting (token-bucket + semaphore), exponential backoff (1s→2s→4s+jitter, max 30s), response caching (SHA-256 keyed, ~500 entry LRU)

### Agentic Detection Protocol
Each flow analysis uses a multi-turn tool-use loop (max 5 turns):
- `READ_FILE <path>` — read a file from the target repo
- `READ_FUNCTION <fn_id>` — read function body by IR node ID
- `RECORD_FACT "<fact>"` — record a discovery
- `FINISH {"verdict": "safe"|"likely_safe"|"suspicious"|"malicious", "vuln_type": "...", ...}`

## Deterministic Rules (`rules.py`)

7 rules registered via `@rule(name, severity, description)` decorator:

| Rule | Severity | Detection |
|---|---|---|
| `unvalidated-source-to-sink` | HIGH | Any source→sink flow without validation |
| `missing-authentication` | HIGH | Unprotected API routes |
| `database-write-without-validation` | MEDIUM | DB writes on unvalidated paths |
| `exposed-network-request` | MEDIUM | External requests on tainted paths |
| `sql-injection-via-concat` | HIGH | String concatenation in DB calls |
| `path-traversal` | HIGH | Path manipulation in file operations |
| `ssrf-dynamic-url` | MEDIUM | Dynamic URL in network requests |

## Security Graph Schema

The security graph (`build_security_graph_from_ir()`) returns a dict:

```python
{
  "flows": [{"id", "source", "source_fnid", "sink", "sink_fnid", "sink_type",
              "path", "path_labels", "validated", "validators", "expressions", "operations"}],
  "subgraphs": {
    "auth": {"protected": [...], "unprotected": [...], "total", "protected_count", "unprotected_count"},
    "database": {"operations": [...], "total"},
    "network": {"operations": [...], "total"}
  },
  "summary": {"total_sources", "total_sinks", "total_routes", "total_flows",
              "unvalidated_flows", "flows_by_sink_type"}
}
```

## Testing

86 tests across 5 files. Run with:

```bash
python -m pytest tests/ -v
```

- `tests/test_ir.py` (651 lines) — IR model construction, serialization, provenance edges, symbol resolution
- `tests/test_phase3.py` (364 lines) — Call graph, sink detection, taint engine (basic, sanitized, dedup, cross-module)
- `tests/test_agentic_detector.py` (265 lines) — GlobalMemory, discovery, agentic flow, consistency reconciliation
- `tests/test_detector.py` (78 lines) — LLM detector integration with mock client
- `tests/test_config.py` (42 lines) — Config loading and model override resolution

## Design Principles

1. **Local-first by default** — Code never leaves the machine. Zero API cost.
2. **Convention over exhaustion** — Heuristic tagging for code semantics; security decisions deferred to LLM.
3. **Deterministic + AI hybrid** — Fast rules run always; LLM adds deep analysis on flagged flows.
4. **Pipeline architecture** — Each phase produces cached JSON consumed by the next; re-runnable independently.
5. **Never exit on errors** — Clone failures, invalid commands — all loop back to the prompt.
6. **Progressive enhancement** — More languages, deeper analysis, better LLM agents added incrementally.

## Environment Variables

- `ULTRON_LLM_MODE` — override `local`/`cloud`
- `ULTRON_NO_LLM` — skip LLM detection
- `ULTRON_DEBUG` — enable verbose tracing
- `ULTRON_VISUALISE` — auto-open SVGs

## Output Files

All generated under `workspace/<repo>/`:
- `manifest.json` — language/framework detection
- `ast/ast.json` — parsed AST
- `ir/` — IR modules
- `dependency_graph.svg` — role-colored module dependency graph
- `taint_graph.svg` — source→sink propagation paths
- `security_graph.svg` — flow chains + subgraphs
